judge_identity: reviewer-assisted judge (reviewer-assisted pass), independent blinded semantic coverage judgment from packet text only

judging_policy.direct: same core visible fact and substantially same reasoning operation
judging_policy.partial: clear semantic overlap in the core visual fact, with only part of entity/time/condition/reasoning overlapping
judging_policy.absent: different core fact; same video, actor, object, or nearby event alone is not coverage
judging_policy.uncertain: reserved for text-insufficient cases requiring review

notes: Generated ids were constrained to the ids listed in each packet row; no existing judge outputs, mappings, labels, metadata, answers, or model results were read.
